passage.label: O Prophet why prohibit what Allah made lawful seeking approval wives Allah Forgiving Merciful; Allah ordained dissolution oaths Allah protector Knowing Wise; when Prophet confided wife statement she informed another Allah showed him made known part ignored part informed her said who told you said informed Knowing Acquainted; if two repent Allah best hearts deviated cooperate against him indeed Allah protector Gabriel righteous believers angels assistants; perhaps Lord if divorced substitute wives better submitting believing devoutly obedient repentant worshipping traveling previously married virgins

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَۖ تَبۡتَغِي مَرۡضَاتَ أَزۡوَٰجِكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
قَدۡ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ تَحِلَّةَ أَيۡمَٰنِكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

وَإِذۡ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضِ أَزۡوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثٗا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتۡ بِهِۦ وَأَظۡهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ عَرَّفَ بَعۡضَهُۥ وَأَعۡرَضَ عَنۢ بَعۡضٖۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتۡ مَنۡ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَاۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ صَغَتۡ قُلُوبُكُمَاۖ وَإِن تَظَٰهَرَا عَلَيۡهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوۡلَىٰهُ وَجِبۡرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۖ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ
عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبۡدِلَهُۥٓ أَزۡوَٰجًا خَيۡرٗا مِّنكُنَّ مُسۡلِمَٰتٖ مُّؤۡمِنَٰتٖ قَٰنِتَٰتٖ تَـٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتٖ سَـٰٓئِحَٰتٖ ثَيِّبَٰتٖ وَأَبۡكَارٗا

mainSubject.label: The Prophet questioned for prohibiting what Allah made lawful in seeking his wives' approval, under forgiveness and mercy; oath-dissolution already ordained by Allah as protector, Knowing and Wise; the confidential statement disclosed by one wife to another, shown to him by Allah so he made part known and ignored part, identifying the source as the Knowing and Acquainted; both wives called to repentance since their hearts had deviated, warned that cooperating against him would meet Allah as protector alongside Gabriel, righteous believers and angels as assistants; the possibility raised that divorce would bring better wives — submissive, believing, obedient, repentant, worshipping, travelling, previously married or virgins

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the better-wives substitution scenario (5) before the fire-protection command opens (6); P2 ends with the jihad-harshness command and Hell-refuge verdict (9) before the four-women exempla block begins (10); P3 covers the two disbelieving and two believing women exemplars (10-12).
